 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 2 19-10-2023 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Baliya Belon P.S. Case No. 135 of 2022 registered under Sections 341, 323, 376, 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case.
The Complaint Case is lodged after lapse of four months of the alleged occurrence.
Further he submits that the victim in her statements recorded under Section 164 Cr. P.C. specifically stated that she loves with the petitioner and always used to talk with him on mobile.
The medical report also does not support the allegation as alleged.
It Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.67790 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023
is further submitted that petitioner has no criminal antecedent.

4. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing personal bonds to the satisfaction of the Additional Sessions Md.
